The '''Fifth Infantry''' was a military unit in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the unit was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where its [[First Battalion]] under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Piloc]] was send to retrieve the plans for a neutron detonator from the ruins of [[Bugtown]].<ref name="AQoM" />
